## 2. The distinction that matters

Reachable from the public API is **not** operationally exercised, and operationally exercised is **not** independently verified. The inventory keeps these apart:

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `implemented` | has public functions, at least one test reference |
| `partial` | has public functions but no test reference |
| `disconnected` | no caller outside its own directory, or nothing to persist |
| `stub` | public API returns canned values only |
